name: OmaCar
author: prezziej
description: The car in the menu bar: a steering wheel that fills in when the engine is turning, and a panel with what it is doing now, how it has driven by day, week, month and year, every trouble code it is holding, and the whole service book.

barWidget.description: Live OBD-II readings, performance history, faults and the service schedule. Click for the panel, right-click for the cluster.
